offering_description.value: Holds royalty interests in respiratory medicines developed with partners and sells specialty antibiotics and a critical care drug to hospitals in the US. It earns royalty payments from partner drug sales and product sales to hospitals and wholesalers.

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and drug wholesalers buying specialty drugs, pharmaceutical partners paying royalties

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: royalties on respiratory drugs sold by pharmaceutical partners; product sales: antibiotics and critical care drugs sold to hospitals

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: commercializes specialty hospital drugs, sold to hospitals and wholesalers; other: owns royalty interests in respiratory drugs made and sold by partners

geography_served.value: global: US hospitals for product sales, royalties on partner sales in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: respiratory drug royalty interests, hospital antibiotics, critical care drug

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: drug wholesalers supplying hospitals; direct sales: specialty sales force calling on hospitals; other: royalty payments received from pharmaceutical partners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval needed to sell drugs in the US, royalty revenue depends on partners' approvals

notes: Product portfolio and royalty terms may have changed; details are based on my general knowledge and may be incomplete.
